title: How to change the desk
lede: What you can change from the screens, and what needs code.

slides.cap: Fix an item where it is now. Content Sort asks for the desk password.

notes.html: Delete is final once you reload or close the desk. To bring an item back, add its link again on Submit content.
Never fix an item in the Sheet's first tab. It is a copy: the desk never reads it and writes over it.

steps.title: Where it is now
items: On Content Sort: type over the title, or press Edit under the description; each saves when you click away. For the link, press Change, then Save.
Kept, and not yet in an issue or live: Edit on Finalize, then Save.
Waiting on Publish: click the row, then Edit.

slides.cap: Edit on Next issue, Finalize and Publish opens this form.

notes.html: Fix an item kept under the wrong type here, without deleting it.

slides.cap: Next issue holds the items. The builder holds the draft.

steps.title: An issue
items: To fill a later issue, press its date beside Later under This issue.
Build each issue on one computer: the draft lives in that browser.
Edits on Preview & Tweak change the email, not the desk.
To fix an archived issue, fix it in the builder on the same computer and press Save to the archive again. This works only until you press Start the next issue.

slides.cap: A change on the Sheet reaches the desk within ten minutes; reload to see it. If it never does, see Bring back the Google scripts.

notes.html: Type each date in column A, from row 2, as 2026-11-10.

slides.cap: Once an item is live, no Edit on the desk reaches the site. Only Highlight's card words and photo do, in the home page's big card.

notes.html: The desk's Delete never touches the site.

slides.cap: Fix a live item on the site itself. Use a laptop: the site's Edit buttons do not show on a phone.

notes.html: Find the item on the site, press Edit, fix it, press Save. Hide from the site, in the same Edit, takes it down.
The big card never shows a Drive picture. Use Add photo on Highlight, or a picture link ending .jpg, .png or .webp.
Publish and Highlight ask for the desk password at Confirm.

slides.cap: To see Sheet 1 as it is now, reload the browser page.
Rows you delete on the Newsletter scrapes tabs stay deleted.

notes.html: The scraper does not read the Scraper sources Sheet. Changing its sources needs code.

below:
Needs code

Ask the desk's owner, named in READ ME FIRST - ERC handoff, in the shared drive. With access to the repo, Claude Code can make the change.
